title: Four funded players, and Traversal is a third of the leader

rows.label: Resolve AI
rows.detail: TechCrunch reported the effective valuation was lower because of a multi-tranche structure; the company calls the round non-blended. The $1B is contested: TechCrunch reported a lower effective valuation from a multi-tranche structure; the company calls the round non-blended.

rows.label: Traversal
rows.note: Seed and A Jun 2025 + Amex Mar 2026
rows.detail: $48M across seed and Series A, plus a $5M strategic investment from Amex Ventures.

caption: The memo's table had Traversal at '$48M plus an undisclosed Amex round'. The round was disclosed, at $5 million, in the memo's own cited source. Resolve AI's ~$4M revenue is left off this chart. It is an anonymously sourced December 2025 figure, not contemporaneous with the valuation.
source: Goodwin and Built In NYC, June 2025; SiliconANGLE, March 4, 2026; resolve.ai, February 4, 2026; incident.io, April 2025; VVUS, December 2025.
